subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider?
rationale: The source confirms stale visible copy, but choosing between the issue's proposed wording, Google's current Gemini Enterprise/Vertex wording, and the existing label is maintainer-owned product copy.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise wording
options.body: Update only visible labels and docs to a Gemini Enterprise/Vertex phrasing while keeping all `google-vertex` identifiers unchanged.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Match the reporter's wording exactly, accepting that it may not line up with the current Google Cloud docs wording.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI
options.body: Leave current copy until maintainers decide the Google Cloud product rename is stable enough for OpenClaw UI/docs.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise wording
recommendation.body: Update only visible labels and docs to a Gemini Enterprise/Vertex phrasing while keeping all `google-vertex` identifiers unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: This login has the strongest recent history on the Google provider setup/catalog surface and is already mentioned in the issue discussion for the decision.
